title: Format native 128-bit and bit-precise integers
problem: Standard type traits do not consistently recognize native extended integers.
design: Explicit signed and unsigned traits preserve the native width. _BitInt support follows the oracle surface through 64 bits.
tradeoffs: Compiler extensions are conditional. Wider _BitInt values report unsupported rather than narrowing.
source_changes: Native extension test now returns77 when int128 is unavailable, so absence is recorded as skip rather than a passing empty test. Formatter logic is unchanged.
